zh-CN.title: 修复系统通知连接与状态显示
items: 修复前台页面导致系统通知被跳过的问题，增强 iOS WebAPP 推送可靠性
通知设置明确展示检查中、检查失败和待重新连接，避免开关先关后开的误导
失效订阅不再静默重建，可主动重新连接或关闭；推送链路区分服务接收与客户端处理

en.title: More reliable system notifications
items: System notifications are no longer skipped because a page is visible, improving iOS WebAPP reliability
Notification settings clearly distinguish checking, check failures and connections needing repair
Lost subscriptions require an explicit reconnect and can be turned off; delivery traces distinguish service acceptance from client handling
